user.title: Sign in to ČEZ
user.description: How do you sign in to ČEZ Distribuce?

menu_options.browser_login: With Google, Apple or in a browser (hourly data and outages only)

password.title: Sign in to ČEZ
password.description: Enter your login details for the ČEZ Distribuce portal (dip.cezdistribuce.cz).

browser_login.title: Sign in in a browser (Google / Apple)
browser_login.description:
1. On a **computer**, open this link and sign in the way you normally do (Google, Apple or password):

[Sign in to ČEZ]({authorize_url})

2. After signing in, the browser tries to open an address starting with `{redirect_uri}` and nothing seems to happen. Copy that address: in Firefox it is in the address bar; in Chrome/Edge open Developer tools (F12) → Network (tick Preserve log) before signing in, and from the last `authorize` request with status 302 copy the `Location` response header.

3. Paste it here **quickly** – the code is only valid for a short time.

Do not open the link on a phone with the Proud app installed – the app takes the code itself. The integration does not store your Google/Apple credentials, only a ČEZ access token.

browser_supply_point.title: Supply point
browser_supply_point.description:
Without portal access the integration cannot list your supply points. EANs found automatically: {ean_count}. The EAN (18 digits) is on your invoice or in the Proud app. The business partner number was prefilled from your account if ČEZ provided it.

With this sign-in method, meter readings, HDO and sensors derived from them are not available – only hourly consumption/production (Energy dashboard) and outages.

select_supply_point.title: Select supply point
select_supply_point.description: Multiple supply points were found. Select the one you want to monitor.

select_hdo_signal.title: Select HDO signal
select_hdo_signal.description: {signal_count} HDO signals were found. Select the one that matches your tariff (you can find it in your contract or invoice).

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate with ČEZ
reauth_confirm.description: The ČEZ Distribuce portal rejected the stored password for {username}. Enter the current password.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure ČEZ
reconfigure.description: Change the credentials for supply point {ean}. The integration also re-detects which portal environment (Household/Business) the supply point belongs to.

error.invalid_auth: Invalid login details. Check your email and password.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to ČEZ API. Please try again.
error.no_supply_points: No supply point associated with this account was found.
error.portal_action_required: After login the ČEZ Distribuce portal requires an action (accepting terms, a contract or selecting an environment). Log in once at dip.cezdistribuce.cz in a browser and try again.
error.supply_point_not_found: The supply point of this integration is not visible under this account in any portal environment.
error.portal_unavailable: The ČEZ Distribuce portal is temporarily unavailable (it returns its start page instead of data, typically during nightly maintenance). Please try again later.
error.portal_no_data_access: Login succeeded, but the ČEZ Distribuce portal returns no supply points for this account. Check that you can see your supply points after logging in at dip.cezdistribuce.cz in a browser. A Můj ČEZ (ČEZ Prodej) account alone is not enough, and the supply point must be in the ČEZ Distribuce area (not PREdistribuce or EG.D).
error.invalid_redirect_url: No code was found in the address. Paste the whole address starting with cda://validation/?code=...
error.state_mismatch: The address belongs to a different sign-in attempt. Use the new link below and sign in again.
error.code_expired: The code has expired or was already used. Sign in again using the new link and paste the address faster.
error.browser_login_failed: Signing in in the browser ended with an error. Try again using the new link.
error.scope_retry: ČEZ rejected the requested permissions. The link was adjusted – please sign in again.
error.no_refresh_token: ČEZ did not issue a long-lived token, so the integration would stop working shortly. Use password sign-in instead.
error.invalid_partner: The business partner number must contain digits only.
error.pnd_check_failed: ČEZ returned no hourly data for this EAN and partner. Check the EAN, partner number and type (consumption/production); the supply point needs a smart meter.

abort.already_configured: This supply point (EAN) is already configured.

init.title: Electricity prices
init.description: Prices used by the Current price sensor. The integration reloads after saving.
